Container.Name: Dipolar App
Container.Overview: Dipolar (Streamio IPTV) web app: React UI + nginx. Proxies /api to the Dipolar Server container. Open this port in your browser for the full app.
Container.Description: Web UI for Dipolar. Requires Dipolar Server running with Host network (so the API is on port 3333 on the Unraid host). This container reaches it via host.docker.internal:3333. No custom network or Network dropdown needed.

Config.Name: WebUI
Config.Description: Host port for the web app
